question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Pernicious**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Innocuous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pernicious"** means something that is highly harmful, destructive, or detrimental, often in a gradual or subtle way. (हानिकारक, घातक)
 
 
• **Example: **The pernicious effects of pollution on the environment are becoming increasingly evident.
 
 
• **"Innocuous"** refers to something that is not harmful or offensive. It is the direct antonym of "pernicious." (हानिरहित)
 
 
• **Example: **The comment was innocuous and did not offend anyone in the room.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'pernicious'** is **'innocuous'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Innocuous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Harmful** (हानिकारक): Something that causes damage or injury.
 
 
• **Example: **Smoking is harmful to your health.
 
 
• **Virulent** (अत्यधिक विषैला): Something that is extremely severe or harmful in its effects.
 
 
• **Example: **The virus turned out to be highly virulent, spreading rapidly among the population.
 
 
• **Noxious** (हानिकारक): Something harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant.
 
 
• **Example: **Noxious fumes from the factory polluted the surrounding air.
 

36:T662,

The correct answer is **option 2.**
